lines.zh: 我提着铁剑，沿着大路慢慢走。
lines.en: I carry an iron sword and walk the road slowly.

lines.zh: 靴子磨破了，我用草绳绑了两圈。
lines.en: My boots are worn; I tied them twice with grass rope.

lines.zh: 我绕过那片林子，里面昨晚有响动。
lines.en: I skirt that wood; something moved there last night.

lines.zh: 一步一停，我得先看清前面。
lines.en: A step, then a pause; I look ahead before moving.

lines.zh: 锁链甲在肩上响，声音太吵。
lines.en: My chainmail rattles at the shoulder, far too loud.

lines.zh: 我背着面包走，面包不多了。
lines.en: I walk with bread on my back, and there is little left.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，这样能听见僵尸。
lines.en: I go slowly so I can hear the zombies coming.

lines.zh: 草地上的露水浸湿了我的裤脚。
lines.en: Dew on the grass soaks through my trousers.

lines.zh: 我在雪里走，脚印一深一浅。
lines.en: I walk through snow, one print deep and one shallow.

lines.zh: 我绕开村庄，那里夜里守不住。
lines.en: I avoid the village; it cannot be held at night.

lines.zh: 我沿着河走，水能掩住气味。
lines.en: I follow the river; water hides my scent.

lines.zh: 走了四十步，我就回头看一眼。
lines.en: Every forty paces, I look back over my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我靠着树坐下，剑放在膝盖上。
lines.en: I sit against a tree, sword laid across my knees.

lines.zh: 我清点面包，还剩三块。
lines.en: I count my bread; three pieces left.

lines.zh: 我在磨剑，石头一下一下擦过刃。
lines.en: I hone the blade, and the stone scrapes along the edge.

lines.zh: 我抬头看太阳，想知道还剩多久。
lines.en: I look at the sun to see how much daylight remains.

lines.zh: 我替自己包了一下手上的伤口。
lines.en: I wrap the cut on my hand with a strip of cloth.

lines.zh: 风里有腐肉味，我握紧了剑。
lines.en: Rotten flesh is on the wind; I tighten my grip.

lines.zh: 我坐着不出声，等天色暗下来。
lines.en: I sit without a sound and wait for the light to fail.

lines.zh: 我把马鞍擦了擦，那马不会再回来。
lines.en: I wipe the saddle; that horse is not coming back.

lines.zh: 我数着自己的呼吸，让手不抖。
lines.en: I count my breaths to keep my hands steady.

lines.zh: 我在想，还能撑几个晚上。
lines.en: I wonder how many more nights I can last.

lines.zh: 你走近了，我先看你的手。
lines.en: You come closer; I look at your hands first.

lines.zh: 你的剑没拔，那我就先不拔。
lines.en: Your sword is sheathed, so mine stays where it is.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛不像僵尸，我就放心一半。
lines.en: Your eyes are not a zombie's, so I relax a little.

lines.zh: 你身上没有腐肉味，这很好。
lines.en: You do not smell of rotten flesh; that is good.

lines.zh: 我在看你是不是也一个人。
lines.en: I am checking whether you are alone too.

lines.zh: 你手上那把剑，比我的是新的。
lines.en: That sword of yours is newer than mine.

lines.zh: 你从哪个方向来，那边还安全吗。
lines.en: Which way did you come from, and is it still safe?

lines.zh: 别靠太近，我看不清你的时候会动手。
lines.en: Not too close; I swing when I cannot see clearly.

lines.zh: 你也在找一个能过夜的地方吧。
lines.en: You are looking for a night's shelter too, I think.

lines.zh: 我记住了你的脸，别在背后动刀。
lines.en: I have your face in mind; do not knife me from behind.

lines.zh: 你砍中我的肩，我咬住牙没出声。
lines.en: You cut my shoulder; I bite down and stay silent.

lines.zh: 血顺着袖子流，我握剑更紧了。
lines.en: Blood runs down my sleeve, and I grip tighter.

lines.zh: 这一下让我想起失去的人。
lines.en: This wound brings back the ones I lost.

lines.zh: 我退了两步，重新举剑。
lines.en: I give two steps and raise the sword again.

lines.zh: 这一下疼得实在，我还活着。
lines.en: This one hurts properly, so I am still alive.

lines.zh: 你的刀口很浅，我的甲挡了一半。
lines.en: Your cut is shallow; my armor took half of it.

lines.zh: 我按住伤口，指缝全是红的。
lines.en: I press the wound and my fingers come away red.

lines.zh: 我吐了一口血，还能走。
lines.en: I spit blood and can still walk.

lines.zh: 别以为我倒了，我跪着也能砍。
lines.en: Do not think I am down; I can cut from my knees.

lines.zh: 我会记住这笔账，等你背对我。
lines.en: I will remember this when your back is turned.

lines.zh: 你递来面包，我先看你的另一只手。
lines.en: You offer bread; I check your other hand first.

lines.zh: 我不白拿，我用一块铁换。
lines.en: I do not take charity; I trade a piece of iron.

lines.zh: 食物我收下，但剑我不会放下。
lines.en: I will take the food, but I keep my sword.

lines.zh: 你把面包掰开，我闻到了酵母。
lines.en: You break the bread and I smell the yeast.

lines.zh: 饿太久的人，看见食物会先愣一下。
lines.en: Starve long enough and food makes you freeze.

lines.zh: 我不吃别人手里的东西，除非他先咬一口。
lines.en: I eat nothing from a hand unless it bites first.

lines.zh: 你拿食物引我，我不是野猪。
lines.en: You lure me with food; I am not a boar.

lines.zh: 这块面包够我撑到明天早上。
lines.en: This bread will keep me until tomorrow morning.

lines.zh: 我收下了，欠你一次。
lines.en: I take it and owe you one.

lines.zh: 别用食物换我的命，那太便宜。
lines.en: Do not trade food for my life; it is too cheap.

lines.zh: 你撞到我，我第一反应是抓剑柄。
lines.en: You bump me and my first move is for the hilt.

lines.zh: 我们肩撞肩，都退了一步。
lines.en: Shoulder against shoulder, we both step back.

lines.zh: 别贴这么近，我背后还有伤口。
lines.en: Not so close; I have a wound on my back.

lines.zh: 我抬手挡了一下，是习惯。
lines.en: I raise an arm to block; it is habit.

lines.zh: 你的护甲撞出响声，会引来东西。
lines.en: Your armor clangs, and clanging draws company.

lines.zh: 站稳，别把火把撞掉了。
lines.en: Stand steady; do not knock the torch loose.

lines.zh: 我们挤过同一道门，木头在响。
lines.en: We squeeze through one doorway and the wood creaks.

lines.zh: 撞我就算了，别碰我的面包。
lines.en: Bump me if you must, but leave my bread alone.

lines.zh: 我侧身让你过，这条路窄。
lines.en: I turn sideways to let you pass; the path is narrow.

lines.zh: 碰一下不算挑衅，我懂。
lines.en: A bump is not a challenge; I know that.

lines.zh: 上回有人陪我走了三天，后来没回来。
lines.en: Someone walked with me three days, then did not return.

lines.zh: 半个世界是女人，可活下来的没几个。
lines.en: Half the world is women, but few of them live.

lines.zh: 我把多余的面包分给过一个姑娘。
lines.en: I once shared my spare bread with a girl.

lines.zh: 我们没成家，只一起守过一夜。
lines.en: We built no home, only guarded one night together.

lines.zh: 我留着一枚戒指，不知道给谁。
lines.en: I keep a ring and do not know who should have it.

lines.zh: 她死在僵尸嘴里，我砍了那几只。
lines.en: She died in a zombie's jaws; I cut those ones down.

lines.zh: 有人一起走，夜会短一点。
lines.en: With someone beside me, the night runs shorter.

lines.zh: 我不说喜欢，我只说别走远。
lines.en: I do not say love; I say do not wander off.

lines.zh: 我给她留过一半火把，她拿走了。
lines.en: I saved her half a torch and she took it.

lines.zh: 成双的人容易招来更多僵尸。
lines.en: Pairs draw more zombies than lone walkers do.

lines.zh: 地上有把断剑，我捡起来当铁料。
lines.en: A broken sword lies there; I pick it up as iron.

lines.zh: 我捡起一块面包，吹掉上面的土。
lines.en: I pick up a piece of bread and blow the dirt off.

lines.zh: 这副皮甲还合身，就是有点旧。
lines.en: This leather armor fits, though it is worn.

lines.zh: 我捡起一根铁锭，掂了掂，值钱。
lines.en: I pick up an iron ingot, weigh it, and it is worth keeping.

lines.zh: 我捡起那顶头盔，里面还有血。
lines.en: I pick up the helmet; there is still blood inside.

lines.zh: 有人掉的金护甲，穿上太亮。
lines.en: Someone dropped gold armor; it shines too much.

lines.zh: 我把药水塞进包里，留着救命。
lines.en: I tuck the potion in my pack to save a life.

lines.zh: 这匹马的马鞍我拆了，马没回来。
lines.en: I strip the saddle; the horse never came back.

lines.zh: 我捡起一把箭，箭羽还干净。
lines.en: I pick up some arrows; the fletching is still clean.

lines.zh: 能拿的都拿，明天也许用得上。
lines.en: I take what I can; tomorrow may need it.

lines.zh: 那边有僵尸，我先数清楚几只。
lines.en: Zombies over there; I count them before I move.

lines.zh: 你刚才打了我一下，这事没完。
lines.en: You struck me once, and that is not finished.

lines.zh: 它咬过活人，我不能留它。
lines.en: It has bitten the living; I cannot leave it.

lines.zh: 三只，从林子里出来了。
lines.en: Three of them, coming out of the trees.

lines.zh: 我看到它抓着门，那就得先杀它。
lines.en: I see it clawing at a door, so it dies first.

lines.zh: 它挡在我和马之间，那就选它。
lines.en: It stands between me and the horse, so it goes first.

lines.zh: 目标定了，是那只会跑的。
lines.en: Target chosen: the one that runs.

lines.zh: 它咬了我的同伴，我要它偿。
lines.en: It bit my companion, and I will collect.

lines.zh: 别管我，先解决右面那只。
lines.en: Do not mind me; take the one on the right.

lines.zh: 你偷袭我，我记住了你的位置。
lines.en: You ambushed me; I have your position marked.

lines.zh: 它是从洞里爬出来的，一只都不会放过。
lines.en: They crawled out of that hole; none of them gets away.

lines.zh: 我先动，僵尸从不给第二次机会。
lines.en: I move first; zombies never grant a second chance.

lines.zh: 村里还有人，我不能退。
lines.en: There are still people in the village; I cannot retreat.

lines.zh: 它身上那件衣甲，我要拿回来。
lines.en: The armor it wears was someone's; I will take it back.

lines.zh: 那边有只僵尸在拆门，先它。
lines.en: A zombie is breaking a door over there; it first.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，剑尖朝前。
lines.en: I lower my body and point the sword forward.

lines.zh: 它转身了，我跟着换步。
lines.en: It turns, and I shift my feet with it.

lines.zh: 我数着它的距离，三步就够。
lines.en: I measure the gap; three paces will do.

lines.zh: 火把在我左手，光晃它的眼。
lines.en: The torch is in my left hand; the light blinds it.

lines.zh: 我绕到侧面，僵尸不会转身快。
lines.en: I circle to its flank; zombies turn slowly.

lines.zh: 它靠近门，我得挡在门前面。
lines.en: It nears the door, and I must stand in front.

lines.zh: 我憋住气，腐肉味太重。
lines.en: I hold my breath; the rotten stench is thick.

lines.zh: 它在犹豫，我不等它想明白。
lines.en: It hesitates, and I do not wait for it to decide.

lines.zh: 剑举到肩膀高，这一下要断它的颈。
lines.en: My sword comes to shoulder height for its neck.

lines.zh: 我脚跟踩实，别被它扑倒。
lines.en: I plant my heels so it cannot tackle me down.

lines.zh: 它绕着我转，我也绕着它转。
lines.en: It walks around me; I keep my blade between us.

lines.zh: 左边有响动，可能还有一只。
lines.en: Something moves on the left; there may be another.

lines.zh: 我把面包塞回包里，手要空出来。
lines.en: I stuff the bread away so my hands are free.

lines.zh: 它扑过来之前，我先出手。
lines.en: Before it lunges, I strike first.

lines.zh: 我贴着墙走，把火把藏到身后。
lines.en: I creep along the wall, torch behind my back.

lines.zh: 它背对着我，脚步再轻一点。
lines.en: Its back is turned; I lighten my step.

lines.zh: 我数它挥手的间隔，等空档。
lines.en: I time its swings and wait for a gap.

lines.zh: 它的头转向别处，我上前一步。
lines.en: Its head turns away and I take a step in.

lines.zh: 铁剑落下，十点伤害，它退了。
lines.en: The iron sword falls for ten and it falls back.

lines.zh: 空手也有四分力，别小看我。
lines.en: Even bare-handed I hit for four; do not underestimate me.

lines.zh: 我砍它的膝盖，先让它跪下。
lines.en: I cut its knee so it kneels first.

lines.zh: 这一剑劈开它的肩，腐肉飞了。
lines.en: The blade splits its shoulder and rot flies.

lines.zh: 我横着扫，逼它离门远点。
lines.en: I sweep sideways to push it away from the door.

lines.zh: 它抓到我小臂，我照砍不误。
lines.en: It rakes my forearm, and I keep cutting.

lines.zh: 我把剑当棍用，砸它的头。
lines.en: I use the sword like a club and hammer its skull.

lines.zh: 它倒了，我再补一下。
lines.en: It goes down, and I add one more.

lines.zh: 我的手在抖，但剑没偏。
lines.en: My hand shakes, but the blade stays true.

lines.zh: 它咬空了一口，我趁机劈下去。
lines.en: It bites only air, and I chop down.

lines.zh: 剑刃卡在骨头里，我抬脚踹开。
lines.en: The blade sticks in bone; I kick it free.

lines.zh: 我背后有人，先把前面这只解决。
lines.en: Someone is behind me; this one dies first.

lines.zh: 这一下是为了村里那扇门。
lines.en: This blow is for the village door.

lines.zh: 我喘得厉害，可我还站得住。
lines.en: I am gasping hard, but I am still standing.

lines.zh: 这一剑劈在它肩上，卡住了。
lines.en: The blade bites its shoulder and sticks.

lines.zh: 我用剑柄砸它太阳穴。
lines.en: I slam the pommel into its temple.

lines.zh: 我在草坡上睁眼，天刚亮。
lines.en: I wake on a grassy slope just after dawn.

lines.zh: 我记不清自己从哪来，只记得要活。
lines.en: I do not recall where I came from, only that I must live.

lines.zh: 醒来时手里已经握着铁剑。
lines.en: I wake with an iron sword already in hand.

lines.zh: 我身上是锁链甲，不知谁给的。
lines.en: Chainmail is on my back, and I do not know who gave it.

lines.zh: 这是第几个世界，我数不清了。
lines.en: I have lost count of how many worlds this is.

lines.zh: 我从马背上摔下来，马跑了。
lines.en: I fell off a horse, and the horse ran.

lines.zh: 我落在雪原中央，四周白得刺眼。
lines.en: I land in the middle of a snowfield, blinded by white.

lines.zh: 我带着三块面包出现在这里。
lines.en: I appear here with three pieces of bread.

lines.zh: 一睁眼就先摸剑，这是规矩。
lines.en: First thing on waking is to check the sword.

lines.zh: 上一位求生者倒在不远处。
lines.en: The last survivor lies dead not far off.

lines.zh: 这一回我是个女人，剑一样重。
lines.en: This time I am a woman, and the sword weighs the same.

lines.zh: 我从烟里走出来，衣服还带着火味。
lines.en: I walk out of the smoke with fire still in my clothes.

lines.zh: 世界给了我二十点生命和一把剑。
lines.en: The world gave me twenty health and one sword.

lines.zh: 我又站起来了，这次也打算活下去。
lines.en: I am on my feet again, and I mean to keep living.

lines.zh: 火舌舔到我，皮革开始卷边。
lines.en: Flame licks me and my leather starts to curl.

lines.zh: 摔下来时我先护住剑，胳膊断了。
lines.en: Falling, I shield the sword first and break my arm.

lines.zh: 水灌进嘴里，我抓着岸边的草。
lines.en: Water fills my mouth; I clutch at the bank grass.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀进沟里，耳朵嗡嗡响。
lines.en: The blast throws me into a ditch, ears ringing.

lines.zh: 箭穿了我的腿，我砍断箭杆。
lines.en: An arrow goes through my leg; I cut the shaft.

lines.zh: 药水泼过来，我的视线开始发花。
lines.en: A potion splashes over me and my sight blurs.

lines.zh: 饿到第三天，我连剑都举不稳。
lines.en: By the third day hungry, I can barely lift the sword.

lines.zh: 雷打在旁边，我趴下，剑扔远了。
lines.en: Lightning hits nearby; I drop flat and lose the sword.

lines.zh: 脚下没有地，我一直往下掉。
lines.en: There is no ground under me, only falling.
